dogecoin.text: Despite its recent fall, #Crypto investors are being bullish towards Dogecoin and expecting it can reach a $1 mark.

Due to its unlimited supply, it poses a danger to its price compared to other cryptocurrencies like #Bitcoin which has a fixed supply.

Responding to this Musk had said: "Yes, it does." But he later repeated the mantra of dogecoin investors: "To the moon!" 🚀

Earlier this year, Billionaire #ElonMusk had said that #dogecoin could ironically become the future of currencies of earth.

Despite the claim, on Friday, Elon Musk took to #Twitter and said "Cryptocurrency is promising, but please invest with caution!"
